operations.description: Create an API key; the token is returned once (POST /api-keys).
List API keys newest first (GET /api-keys).
Remove an API key (DELETE /api-keys/{api_key_id}).
Add a contact to a segment (POST /contacts/{contact_id}/segments/{segment_id}).
Create a contact, optionally in segments (POST /contacts).
Retrieve a contact by id or e-mail (GET /contacts/{id}).
List contacts newest first, optionally in one segment (GET /contacts).
List the segments of a contact (GET /contacts/{contact_id}/segments).
Remove a contact by id or e-mail (DELETE /contacts/{id}).
Remove a contact from a segment (DELETE /contacts/{contact_id}/segments/{segment_id}).
Update a contact by id or e-mail (PATCH /contacts/{id}).
Add a sending domain and generate its DNS records (POST /domains).
Retrieve a domain with its DNS records (GET /domains/{domain_id}).
List domains newest first (GET /domains).
Remove a domain (DELETE /domains/{domain_id}).
Verify a domain's DNS records (synthetic, instant; POST /domains/{domain_id}/verify).
Cancel a scheduled email (POST /emails/{email_id}/cancel).
Retrieve one email (GET /emails/{email_id}).
List sent emails newest first with cursor pagination (GET /emails).
Send one email synchronously (synthetic delivery; POST /emails).
Send up to 100 emails atomically (POST /emails/batch).
Reschedule a scheduled email (PATCH /emails/{email_id}).
Create a segment (POST /segments).
List segments newest first (GET /segments).
Remove a segment and its memberships (DELETE /segments/{id}).
Team, calling API key and virtual time for the dashboard app.

connections.title: Resend-shaped REST subset (Bearer API key, JSON bodies)
connections.instructions: Point a client's Resend base URL at RESEND_BASE_URL and send RESEND_API_KEY as the Bearer token. Routes mirror /emails, /domains, /api-keys, /segments and /contacts; the calling key is the actor attribute resendApiKeyId, not the token. Compatibility with official SDKs is not verified.
